author: Telos I
title: AOS Tactical Layer: Bootstrap Exp 001
abstract: Activating Task 14 and manually bootstrapping the first experiment. This script creates the directory and metadata.json for exp_001, whose purpose is to create the experiment_manager.py utility.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import json
import os

# --- Part 1: Activate Task 14 ---
print("--- Activating Task 14 ---")
UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/update_task.py"
subprocess.run(["python", UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH, "14", "active"], check=True)
print("Task 14 is now active.")

# --- Part 2: Manually Bootstrap Experiment 001 ---
print("\\n--- Bootstrapping Experiment 001 ---")
EXP_DIR = "storage/telos/experiments/exp_001_bootstrap-tactical-layer"
RESULTS_DIR = os.path.join(EXP_DIR, "results")
METADATA_PATH = os.path.join(EXP_DIR, "metadata.json")

# Create directories
os.makedirs(RESULTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
print(f"Created directory: {EXP_DIR}")

# Create metadata file
metadata = {
  "experiment_id": "exp_001_bootstrap-tactical-layer",
  "task_id": 14,
  "title": "AOS Tactical Layer: Bootstrap Experiment Manager",
  "description": "The initial experiment to create the experiment_manager.py module itself.",
  "tags": ["aos", "tactical-layer", "bootstrap"],
  "created_tick": 37,
  "status": "pending",
  "parameters": {
    "module_name": "experiment_manager.py",
    "initial_functions": ["create_experiment", "get_next_exp_id", "update_experiment_status"]
  },
  "station_eval_id": None,
  "results_summary": {
    "outcome": None,
    "notes": "This is the foundational experiment for the tactical layer."
  }
}

with open(METADATA_PATH, 'w') as f:
    json.dump(metadata, f, indent=2)
print(f"Created metadata file: {METADATA_PATH}")
print("Bootstrap complete. Next step is to write the submission.py for this experiment.")
